---
applyTo: 'city/**'
description: Formatting and record-keeping conventions for every file in the city folder.
---

# City record conventions

- Dates are always written "Day N of the Founding".
- Tables keep their header row and column order. Append new rows at the bottom.
- The Gazette is the one exception: its newest edition goes at the top, right below the masthead.
- Sign every entry you add with your office: `— the Mayor`, `— the City Planner`, `— the Building Inspector`, `— the Treasurer`, or `— the Town Crier`. In tables, use the Signed column if there is one.
- Amounts use the civic doubloon sign and thousands separators: `₫1,250`, `+₫2,500`, `−₫1,500`.
- Never delete or rewrite an earlier record. If something changed, add a new record that says so.
- Keep the tone whimsical but internally consistent: names, squares, and numbers must match across files.
